video:video.video:title: A Musical Promenade | GUC Music Ensemble | TEDxCairo 2014
video:video.video:description:
http://tedxcairo.com http://facebook.com/TEDxCairo http://twitter.com/TEDxCairo
The GUC Music Ensemble was founded in 2010 by musically talented students, offering classical concerts on the universities' campus. Over the past few years it had developed remarkably making the university consider integrating musical activities into an academic context and turning the ensemble from a mere student work to a university managed entity. 2012 the GUC Music Academy project has been initiated by Ohoude Khadr - an opera singer, who obtained her master's degree from the Hanns Eisler Music Academy in Berlin and who is currently also managing and training the ensemble. Since the launch of this project, the GUC Music Academy has been including the ensemble in most of its steps as an appreciation and recognition of its efforts. Today, the ensemble of 60 members is covering a wide range of musical genres: classical, musicals, jazz, blues, rock, pop and Arabic oriental music. It is not only the originals composed by the ensemble's members, but mostly it is the belief in the importance of music in their daily life that makes this musical group stand out
In the spirit of ideas worth spreading, TEDx is a program of local, self-organized events that bring people together to share a TED-like experience. At a TEDx event, TEDTalks video and live speakers combine to spark deep discussion and connection in a small group. These local, self-organized events are branded TEDx, where x = independently organized TED event. The TED Conference provides general guidance for the TEDx program, but individual TEDx events are self-organized.* (*Subject to certain rules and regulations)

video:video.video:title: GUC Documentary: Celebrating 50 Years Ulm University and 15 years GUC
video:video.video:description: Another 'birthday' is celebrated today on the campus of the University of Ulm, namely the #German University in Cairo (GUC) turns 15, which coincides with the 50th anniversary of #Ulm University. The latter along with the University of #Stuttgart were both instrumental in the foundation of the GUC and all are celebrating together today on the 7th of December 2017 their successful journey of success. @German University in Cairo

video:video.video:title: On GUC Campus
video:video.video:description: VIP Visit from the German Ministry of Higher Education Dr. Peter Hassenbech (Head of International Exchanges in Higher Education / Internationalization at the German Ministry of Higher Education.) قام د/ بيتر هازنبخ رئيس التبادل الدولى بوزارة التعليم العالى بألمانيا بزيارة خاصة للجامعة الألمانية بالقاهرة و أعرب عن مدى تقدم التقنيات التكنولوجية بالجامعة كصرح فريد من نوعه فى شمال أفريقيا و الشرق الأوسط.
